notablePrerequisites: Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Guardian Automaton.
When Guardian Automaton dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Guardian Automaton trigger, causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Guardian Automaton on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Guardian Automaton from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Guardian Automaton enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
